intent.purpose: slideshow frame: getting-ready selfie next to a window before going out
intent.scene_concept: close front-camera selfie in a living room, face lit by daylight from a window in front of her while the room behind stays darker
intent.place_type: ordinary apartment living room (not a luxury show home, not a studio)
must_stay_true: strong frontal window daylight on the face with a darker room behind
real apartment clutter in the background

subject.description: one woman with her makeup just done, taking a selfie to check it
subject.action: front-camera selfie held slightly above eye level
subject.pose: facing the window, shoulders square-ish, chin a touch down
subject.gaze: at the screen, near the lens
subject.expression: neutral, relaxed mouth, faint smile in the eyes

identity.skin: warm medium-tan skin, visible pores on nose and cheeks, a few small moles, foundation that does not hide texture
identity.hair: dark brown hair pulled into a low bun with two loose strands at the front and baby hairs at the temple
identity.face: soft everyday makeup: brushed-up brows, mascara, peach blush, nude lip; believable asymmetry

physique.detail: head, neck, shoulders and upper chest in frame

wardrobe.fit_and_condition: satin has small tension creases and one slightly crooked seam

environment.setting: apartment living room in the afternoon
background: grey fabric sofa with a crumpled throw blanket
white radiator under a framed print hung slightly off level
doorway to a hallway with a coat on a hook
a laundry basket half in frame at the right edge
environment.clutter: moderate: throw blanket, laundry basket, TV remote on the sofa arm

camera.position: arm's length, slightly above eye level
camera.depth_of_field: deep; the room is darker rather than blurred

composition.framing: tight upper body from the top of the head to the upper chest
composition.crop: one earring at the frame edge; shoulders cut by the frame

sources: large window in front of her (behind the camera), overcast daylight
one warm ceiling light on in the hallway behind
lighting.direction: frontal and slightly from the left
lighting.quality: bright and fairly soft on the face; the room falls off quickly into shade
lighting.exposure: face well exposed, background a stop or two darker, hallway light slightly clipped

color.white_balance: neutral daylight on the face, warmer in the hallway
casts: warm tungsten cast in the hallway
faint cool cast on the sofa from the window

processing.pipeline: stock iPhone camera app, default settings
processing.hdr: Smart HDR balancing the bright face against the darker room
processing.sharpening: default phone sharpening on lashes and brows
processing.noise_reduction: light noise in the darker room
processing.beauty_filter: none; makeup is the only enhancement

imperfections: slight noise in the darker background
one earring blurred by slight motion
print on the wall hung off level
foundation settling into a fine line under one eye

texture.skin: pores and fine texture visible through light makeup, small moles, slight shine on the nose tip
texture.hair: sleek bun with baby hairs and a few flyaways
texture.surfaces: matte walls, woven sofa fabric, painted radiator

motion.subject: still
motion.blur: none except a touch on one swinging earring

anatomy: selfie arm leaves the frame at the lower left; the other arm is relaxed out of frame
neck and collarbones in believable proportion
physics: earrings hang straight down under gravity
the window light direction matches the shadows on the face

phone.hold: the phone is the camera and is not visible

brands_and_props.branding_policy: keep natural branding if any appears; do not invent logos or readable text

exclusions: no Apple Watch or any smartwatch
no luxury show-home interior, fireplace set-piece or staged decor
no beauty filter, skin smoothing or face reshaping
no ring-light catchlights or studio softbox look
no text, hearts, UI or watermarks
